final_report: The patient demonstrates severe cumulative bone marrow toxicity with recurrent Grade 3-4 neutropenia and thrombocytopenia, indicating limited hematopoietic reserve. Late-onset pulmonary embolism and deep vein thrombosis reflect a hypercoagulable state. Persistent constitutional symptoms and new CNS signs (dizziness, photopsia) suggest multi-organ involvement and declining physiologic reserve, conferring a guarded prognosis despite initial good performance status.
